qa: Why is it flagged?
True CPA $6.87 vs the 18-45 winning set's $5.93 — 16% over. The closest miss of the batch.
What's working?

Subscriber quality, measured on its own 18-45 test subs: LTV $28.94 (4.2x) vs the winning set's $20.18 (3.4x) — it wins on value-per-dollar. A promoted copy already runs in the Adv+ winning set at $26.27 (8.4x, small 13-sub sample).
What's not working?
Cost. 18-45 is expensive and this creative pays 16% more per sub than the incumbents.
Approve or deny?
Lean Approve (promote): its own subs deliver $4.21 of LTV per $1 vs the set's $3.40. If you're strict on CPA, Deny parks it.
What would I retest?
Nothing yet — let it run or promote. If it drifts, retest white vs black background with a tightened headline: static_istoppedstarting_psych11_resentment.

Elite hook: 70.4% of viewers start watching. And its subs are solid: $27.12 LTV (4.9x), just under the set's 5.5x.

Retention: hold is 11.3% — 9 in 10 who start never reach ThruPlay. The leak is the middle of the video, not after signup.

Same hook, cut to testimonial proof within 5s, one CTA: video_whatnobodytells_psych10_chaos and ugc_whatnobodytells_psych3_anxiety.

qa: Why is it flagged?
Judgeable today (crossed ~50 subs Jul 25 + 48h). Winner wildflower's cost sits above the adv+ winning set's benchmark — the bar is the toughest in the account.
What's working?
The istoppedstarting copy keeps converting on new backgrounds: 111 subs in 4 days across 5 arms. Meta concentrated budget on wildflower fast (78% of test spend).
What's not working?
Cost vs the adv+ bar. The parent creative already runs in the winning sets, so this test mostly tells us which BACKGROUND to keep in rotation.
Approve or deny?

Genuine judgment call: it misses the cost bar by ~40%, but its own subs are exceptional — ~$9.5 of LTV per $1 vs the set's ~$5.2 (caveat: 4-day-old subscribers always engage hot, so some of that premium will decay). Promote if you trust the engagement; park if you want the cost bar respected — the copy is already promoted either way.
What would I retest?
Nothing new — this IS the fatigue-refresh test. If parked, wildflower becomes the first-choice background swap when static_testimonial or istoppedstarting tires.

lessons.lesson: Damaging-admission hooks (psych 11) are the only recent test WIN — identity call-out + honest flaw beats the benchmark. Write more in this lane.
examples: white_static_istoppedstarting_psych11_resentment (promoted, closest to bench of the whole batch)

lessons.lesson: Re-skinning a winner doesn't beat the winner — background/format variations of promoted ads all parked. Test new CONCEPTS, not new coats of paint.
Video life-change testimonials pull HIGH-QUALITY subscribers (4.9x LTV) but cost 58–74% over benchmark — right angle, wrong cost. Worth retrying as cheap statics before giving up on the angle.
News-empathy without an identity call-out misses big in BOTH audiences — the 'world went on' framing needs a who-this-is-for hook to clear bench.
examples: static_theworldwenton_psych3_anxiety (+70–76% vs bench in both audiences)

lessons.lesson: A monster hook can't rescue a weak payoff — the 'when you can('t)…' UGC videos hooked 45–74% of viewers (vs ~25–35% norm) but held under 7%, and both audiences missed benchmark. Reuse the OPENER on creative whose first 5 seconds deliver the felt-need promise.
